cover_headline: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses 2 Lakh Tickets in National Chains for Opening Day
facts: Opening-day advance sales across India reached 4.58 lakh tickets and Rs 20.32 crore excluding blocked seats, across 13,317 shows
PVR Inox and Cinepolis sales rose from 1.70 lakh tickets on Saturday to about 2 lakh by Sunday night
The Hindi-language epic, directed by Nitesh Tiwari and starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi, opens on Thursday, November 5

quote.text: The response to Ramayana has been very encouraging, with advance bookings crossing 2.5 lakh tickets across the PVR INOX circuit.
quote.speaker: Sanjeev Kumar Bijli

end.headline: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses 2 Lakh Tickets in National Chains for Opening Day
end.line: PVR Inox and Cinepolis sales for the November 5 opener rose from 1.70 lakh on Saturday to about 2 lakh by Sunday night, with all-India advances at 4.58 lakh tickets.
